open_items: HQ not recorded: coatue.com lists five offices (New York, Menlo Park, San Francisco, Hong Kong, London) but identifies no headquarters. Check size, sectors and application route not stated; Coatue is an asset manager with venture/growth/public arms and no founder pitch route was found.
Funds not recorded: coatue.com gives no fund names, sizes or close dates (CTEK / Coatue Innovation Fund is public-facing at coatuectek.com, not fetched).

Firmus release says the investment is 'expected' and subject to closing conditions (NVIDIA participation also conditional); other outlets describe it as raised. Date is the month on the Firmus page. Firmus HQ not stated ('Asia-based').

Sunday date is the Inforcapital publication date (Mar 28, 2026); the original press release (StreetInsider) returned 403. Mind Robotics Series A was reported by search results as co-led by Accel and a16z, not Coatue, so not recorded. Decagon date is the Built In publication date (Business Wire release said 2026-01-28 in URL). Decagon HQ and website not stated on page.
